thread:
jordan_support: Hey team — AcmeCorp reported 413 from /v1/rerank even though the payload size looks small (≈470KB). They also say rankings changed mid-request, suspect truncation.

alice_support: Can you paste their curl + the exact error body? Also ask for request id if present.

jordan_support: Pasted from customer (sanitized):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\\  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \\\  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\  -d '{"query": "Summarize the contract and flag risks: long query text repeated...", "documents": ["<very long doc 1>...", "<very long doc 2>...", "<... many docs ...>"]}'
```
They say response was HTTP/1.1 413 and body: `{"error":"Payload too large"}` only. No request id in body.

alice_support: Ok thanks. If they saw ranking changes mid-request that's likely server-side truncation before scoring. Ask them to share an anonymized doc that repros or a reduced set. Meanwhile I'll try to repro with a synthetic payload.

maeve_engineer: Repro update — I just sent a payload with 1 query + 120 docs of ~2k chars each and hit 413 at the same point every time. The body byte-size was ~480KB but tokenized length (our BPE tokenizer) was ~72k tokens. Our rerank path enforces a token ceiling (query + all docs) not a raw-bytes ceiling. When the tokenizer exceeds N tokens we return 413. Current 413 message is generic; doesn't say "token limit".

maeve_engineer: Quick repro script (python) I used:
```python
import requests, json
query = 'Important summary ' + ' x'*2000
docs = ['doc ' + ' y'*1500 for _ in range(120)]
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', json={'query': query, 'documents': docs}, headers={'Authorization':'Bearer SK...'})
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```
You can verify token counts with our tokenizer helper (internal).

alice_support: Great catch. Customer error confused bytes with token limit. Can we give them immediate mitigation suggestions?

maeve_engineer: Yes — interim guidance: 1) Send fewer documents per rerank call (batch by N), 2) Snippet the docs to only include the most relevant passage and send those (we should add a small example snippetper), 3) Trim/shorten the query, 4) Use our embeddings+candidate filtering to reduce docset before reranking.

jordan_support: I'll forward those steps to AcmeCorp and ask for a minimal repro doc. They asked if we can change the error body to include token limits.

oscar_docs: +1 we should update KB and API error text. Proposed error body: `{"error":"token limit exceeded","details":"combined tokenized length of query+documents > 65536 tokens"}` and include a link to docs with chunking examples.

maeve_engineer: That looks good. Engineering note: we count tokens with our tokenizer and reject when > 65536 on rerank. Also we do not currently return request_id on 413 — we should attach one for easier triage. I'll file infra tasks.

deploy_bot: Created issue INF-1234: \"rerank: improve 413 message to indicate tokenized input limit + include request_id\" — assigned to maeve_engineer.

alice_support: I'll reply to customer with: short repro steps, mitigation options, ETA to docs update (tomorrow), and ask for a sample that reproduces if they want us to triage deeper.

jordan_support: Sent reply to AcmeCorp with the batching/snippeting options and asked for anonymized sample. They replied saying snippet option is fine as a short-term fix.

oscar_docs: I'll draft the KB article: \"Rerank 413 - tokenized input ceiling\" with curl examples showing how to chunk documents client-side and a small snippet function. Will link INF-1234.

maeve_engineer: After INF-1234 is done we should run a quick canary deploy of the new error payload to ensure clients parsing JSON don't break. Also add the request_id header even before message change if possible.

alice_support: Thanks everyone — keeping thread open until docs + small error-change PR are merged.

jordan_support: Closing loop once docs link + customer confirmation received. :white_check_mark:
